source: Epic C C-PBI-028 post-launch navigation measurement design. No pixels, apps, custom events, or consent behavior changes are authorized by this register.

measures.metricName: Online store search sessions and top searches
measures.question: Are customers using header search to find machines, parts, consumables, and support?
measures.source: Shopify Analytics search reports and online store behavior reports
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Uses Shopify-native aggregate reporting; no new tracking code or consent change.

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Collect four full weeks after launch, segment by device, and set the threshold at the decision review.
thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after Epic C production release
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly analytics review after the 28-day baseline

measures.reviewCadence: Monthly for the first three months, then quarterly.
measures.degradationAction: Review search prominence, menu labels, and zero-result terms before adding custom events.

measures.question: Which customer terms fail to return useful results?
measures.source: Shopify Analytics search reports, Search and Discovery app reports where available
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Uses aggregate Shopify reporting; no new customer-level event collection.

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Collect the first 28 days of query data and define action thresholds by query volume and commercial relevance.
thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after Epic C production release
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly analytics review after the 28-day baseline

measures.degradationAction: Add synonyms, product tags, collection assignments, or content after owner approval.

measures.metricName: Machines collection sessions and product click-through
measures.question: Do customers reaching the Machines route continue to machine product pages?
measures.source: Shopify Analytics collection and product reports
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Uses Shopify aggregate reporting; no new event code.

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Collect the first 28 days after launch and compare mobile and desktop behavior.
thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after Epic C production release
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly analytics review after the 28-day baseline

measures.degradationAction: Review primary navigation label, collection content, product-card clarity, and search merchandising.

measures.metricName: Parts and consumables route sessions and product click-through
measures.question: Do customers find parts and consumables once approved routes exist?
measures.source: Shopify Analytics collection and product reports after approved route creation
measures.owner: Product Owner, Merchandising Owner, and Shopify Admin Owner

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Start baseline only after replacement-parts and consumables destinations are approved and live.
thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after approved parts/consumables routes launch
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly analytics review after that route-specific baseline

measures.degradationAction: Do not add menu links to missing routes; resolve merchandising and route blockers first.

measures.question: Are customers reaching policy pages needed for purchase confidence?
measures.source: Shopify Analytics page reports for published policy URLs
measures.owner: Legal Owner, Content Owner, and Product Owner
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Uses aggregate page reporting; no new tracking code.

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Collect policy page visits for four weeks and review alongside support/contact questions.
thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after Epic C production release
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly analytics review after the 28-day baseline

measures.reviewCadence: Quarterly, with immediate review when policies change.
measures.degradationAction: Review footer policy discoverability and policy content readiness before changing global chrome.

measures.metricName: Contact page sessions and contact form submissions
measures.question: Do support/contact journeys produce successful contact actions?
measures.source: Shopify page reports and native contact form notification or admin evidence where available
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Uses existing form behavior and aggregate page reporting; no new event code.

thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after Epic C production release
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly support review after the 28-day baseline

measures.degradationAction: Review contact page clarity, footer support labels, and unresolved support route ownership.

measures.metricName: Mobile sessions by landing page, collection, product, search, cart, and contact route
measures.question: Do mobile visitors reach the same useful outcomes as desktop visitors?
measures.source: Shopify Analytics device-segmented online store reports
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Uses Shopify aggregate device reporting; no new event code.

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Collect mobile and desktop route outcomes for 28 days, then define acceptable deltas by route.
thresholdOrBaseline.baselineCollectionPeriod: First 28 days after Epic C production release
thresholdOrBaseline.decisionDate: First monthly analytics review after the 28-day baseline

measures.reviewCadence: Monthly for three months, then quarterly.
measures.degradationAction: Run responsive QA, inspect mobile drawer behavior, and review menu labels before adding tracking.

thresholdOrBaseline.method: Record an approved analytics owner and event source before moving any measure out of proposed status.
